AxisLine.description: An explicit line in model coordinates.

direction.description: Direction (ratio components); non-zero, normalised by the engine.

AxisName.description: The world axes usable as an AxisRef (origin at the world origin, direction +X/+Y/+Z).

AxisObject.description: The object forms of an AxisRef; each may carry `flip`.

anyOf.description: An edge, cylinder, datum or explicit line.

BodyOp.description: What a body feature does with its tools (§6.0.3).

anyOf.description: An expression of type Bool, e.g. `"!with_lid"`.

BoolScalar.description:
A boolean field that accepts expressions (SPEC-v1 §2.2, [W0-3]): a JSON boolean, or an
expression string of type Bool.

Capture.description:
Snapshot of a reference's resolution (§5.6): one entry per member of the resolved set, in
canonical order. Canonical JSON, part of the feature's cache key, never shown in CadScript.

faces.description: Edge members: the keys of the two adjacent faces (naming recommendation 5), sorted.

Cardinality.description: Declared cardinality (§5.5): `one`, `some`, `any`, or an exact count `n ≥ 1`.

Carrier.description:
The exact carrier of a captured entity; axis directions are sign-canonical (§3.2), plane
normals outward. Angles in degrees ([W0-7]).

CircularLayout.description: Instances `k = 1 … count−1` rotated by `k·Δ` about the axis.

Constraint.description:
A constraint (§4.3). The 16 kinds, their `type` tags and argument names are exactly
forge-solve's (`forge-solve/src/model.rs`). Arguments are solver entity ids: `p`, `l`,
`l.start`, `l.end`, `a.center`, `c.center`, …; dimension `value`s are Scalars.

oneOf.description: A line is horizontal (relative to the sketch's u axis).
A line is vertical (relative to the sketch's v axis).
Equal length (two lines) or equal radius (two circles/arcs).
Dimension (length): point–point, or point–(infinite) line when `b` is a line.

value.description: Required when driving; forbidden on a reference dimension.

oneOf.description: Dimension (angle): counter-clockwise from line `a` (`p1 → p2`) to line `b`.
Dimension (length): radius of a circle or arc.
Dimension (length): diameter of a circle or arc.
A point lies on the infinite line through `line`.
A point lies on a circle, or on the full circle of an arc.
A point is the midpoint of a line.
Points `a` and `b` are mirror images about `line`.
Pin a point (optionally at `x`, `y`), a line or a circle where it is.

Counterbore.description: Counterbore: the ISO 4762 preset (`HOLE_SIZES`) or explicit `{ d, depth }`.

Countersink.description: Countersink: the ISO 10642 preset (90°) or explicit `{ d, angle }`.

CylinderAxis.description: `{ "cylinder": Ref }` (face, `one`): the axis of a cylindrical or conical face.

DatumPlaneRef.description: `{ "datum": "<feature id>" }`: the frame of an earlier `datum_plane` feature.

Dir.description:
A direction (§3.2): a named direction, a vector (ratio components), or an AxisRef object
(its direction).

DirName.description:
Named directions (§3.2): signed `+X` … `-Z`, and unsigned `X`, `Y`, `Z` (parallel tests
ignore the sign; where a sign is needed they mean `+`).

EdgeAxis.description: `{ "edge": Ref }` (edge, `one`): a line edge's line or a circular edge's axis, sign-canonical.

End.description: `start` / `end` of a sweep or of a curve.

EntityKind.description: The kind of topological entity a reference designates.

ExtrudeExtent.description:
How far an extrude goes when not by a `distance` (§6.2, amendment set F):
`"through_all"` (a cut or intersect through every target) or `{ "up_to": PlaneRef }` (to a
plane parallel to the sketch plane: a planar face, a datum plane or an origin plane).

FacePlane.description: `{ "face": Ref }`: the face frame of §3.1 (kind `face`, card `one`).

origin.description: Projected onto the face plane; default: the world origin.

x_dir.description: Projected onto the face plane; default: the world axis least aligned with the normal.

Feature.description: A feature in the timeline. `type` selects the variant.

oneOf.description:
A 2D sketch (§4). **Explicit** mode when `constraints` is empty (Scalars and compound
curves allowed); **constrained** mode otherwise (literal geometry only, solved by
forge-solve).

extent.description: Amendment set F: through all, or up to a parallel plane, instead of a distance.

oneOf.description:
Transform (§6.13, set F): move, or copy, bodies by a rigid motion — the rotation first,
then the translation. Moved bodies keep their origin and keys; copies are new bodies.

copy.description:
Keep the originals and add moved copies (origin: this feature, the source member,
instance `[1]`; keys `T/copy:{K}@1`, as a one-instance body pattern).

Fingerprint.description: Fingerprint fields of a captured member (§5.6). Values are exact (not tessellated).

local.description: The centroid normalised to the owning body's bounding box.

neighbors.description: Adjacent entities on the same carrier (the split signature).

FingerprintType.description: The canonical type recorded in a fingerprint.

oneOf.description: A face or edge of another type.

FramePlane.description: An explicit frame: `y = normal × x_dir` after re-orthogonalising `x_dir` (v0 [R-14]).

GeomTypeName.description: Canonical surface and curve types a `type` predicate can test (v0 §5).

HoleFit.description: Which table diameter a hole uses (§6.5).

HolePart.description: The faces a hole creates at one position (§5.2 rule 3).

HolePlacement.description: Where the holes go (§6.5): exactly one placement form.

oneOf.description: Sketch points (`point` curves or `<circle>.center`); ids are the point ids.
(u, v) positions in the placement plane's frame.

id.description: The position id (names the hole instance and its faces).

HoleSize.description: Standard metric sizes of the `HOLE_SIZES` table (§6.5).

HoleTip.description:
Drill-point angle of a blind hole, or `"flat"`. The keyword wins over an expression that
names a parameter `flat` ([W0-10]).

Insert.description: Heat-set insert hole: the `std` preset (`HOLE_SIZES`) or explicit `{ d, depth }`.

LinearLayout.description: Instances `(i, j)`, `i < count`, `j < count2`, translated by `i·spacing·u1 + j·spacing2·u2`.

NamedPlane.description:
Named datum planes. Frames (x axis, y axis, normal):
`XY` = (+X, +Y, +Z), `XZ` = (+X, +Z, −Y), `YZ` = (+Y, +Z, +X).

ParamValue.description: A parameter value: a literal number, a literal boolean, or an expression string.

Parameter.description:
A named, typed value. Document-level parameters live in `Document.params`, part-level ones
in `PartStudio.params`; order is declaration order.

Measured parameters (`measure`, §2.1) are **deferred to IR v1.1** (ADR 0013 decision 5);
a `measure` field is rejected with `PARAM_INVALID`.

min.description:
Optional lower bound (literal or expression of the same type), checked after evaluation
(`PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE`). Not allowed for `bool`.

name.description:
Shares the feature-name namespace (§0.3): unique across the document, an identifier,
not in `RESERVED_NAMES` (the full v1 list).

value.description:
A literal (number or boolean) or an expression string (§2.3). A parameter whose value
is an expression is *derived*.

PartStudio.description: An ordered feature timeline that produces a set of bodies.

oneOf.description: Earlier `extrude`, `revolve` or `hole` features of the same part.
Bodies (body, default `some`), copied from the current state.

anyOf.description: An explicit right-handed frame (v0 §2); Scalars allowed.
The face frame of a planar face (§3.1).

PlaneRef.description:
A plane reference (§3.1): a named plane, an explicit frame, the frame of a planar face, or
a `datum_plane` feature.

PointIds.description: A list of sketch point ids, or `"all"` (every `point` curve of the sketch, in curve order).

PointRef.description: A point (§3.2): a literal/expression `P3`, or a vertex.

Predicate.description: One predicate of a `filter` (§5.3); all angle tests use `QUERY_ANGLE_TOLERANCE`.

oneOf.description: F, E: the canonical type is `t`.
F: planar, outward normal equal to the **signed** direction.

E: a line parallel to the direction (either sign). F: a plane whose normal is
perpendicular to it, or a cylinder/cone whose axis is parallel to it.

E: a line perpendicular to it, or a circle whose normal is parallel to it. F: a plane
whose normal is parallel to it (either sign).
E: material angle < 180° − tol. Must be `true`.
E: material angle > 180° + tol. Must be `true`.
E: material angle within tol of 180°. Must be `true`.
F (cylinder, sphere; torus: minor radius), E (circle).

Query.description: The query AST (§5.3). Kinds: **F** faces, **E** edges, **V** vertices, **B** bodies.

oneOf.description:
B, named: bodies whose origin feature is `feature` (with `member`: whose origin region's
outer loop contains `member`), including every piece of a split.
B, broad: every body in scope.
F, named: an extrude's cap faces.
F, named: a revolve's end-cap faces.
F, broad: every side face of the feature.
E, named: the junction edges swept from the sketch vertex at that curve end.

E, named if `a` and `b` are both named: edges with one adjacent face in `a` and the
other in `b`.
F, named: a face a hole created at position `at`.
F, broad: every face whose key has that feature id (and role label).
F, broad: every face of that pattern instance.
The tag's kind; the tag's query re-evaluated in the current scope (§6.12).
B → faces of the bodies; E → the two adjacent faces; V → incident faces.
B → all edges; F → boundary edges; V → incident edges.
F, E, V → the bodies containing them.
Members whose centroid projected on `dir` is within `LINEAR_TOLERANCE·s` of the max (min).
Members of maximal size (area, length or volume).

Ref.description: A reference (§5.1): a typed query plus a declared cardinality, with an optional capture.

capture.description:
Snapshot of what the reference resolved to when it was last accepted (§5.6). Written
only by the command layer.

card.description:
Declared cardinality (§5.5). Omitted means the field's default (canonical JSON omits
a `card` equal to the field's default).

kind.description: Must equal the static kind of `q` and be accepted by the field (`REF_KIND_MISMATCH`).

q.description: The query: the intent of the reference.

RegionSelection.description:
Which regions of the consumed sketch a body feature uses (§4.5): `"all"`, or the curve ids
whose region's outer loop contains them.

anyOf.description: A literal in the field's unit.

Scalar.description:
A numeric field value (SPEC-v1 §2.2 [D-7]): a JSON **number** is a literal in the field's
unit (mm or degrees); a JSON **string** is an expression (§2.3) in canonical form (§2.4).

SketchAxis.description: A revolve axis in the sketch's 2D coordinates (v0 §4.3; Scalars allowed).

oneOf.description: A circular arc from `start` to `end` around `center`, counter-clockwise when `ccw`.
A sketch point: never part of a loop; used by constraints, hole placement and queries.

Compound: a rectangle with optional corner radius. Exactly one of `center` / `corner`
(the lower-left corner).
Compound: a straight slot with round ends centred on `a` and `b`, width `w`.

Compound: a regular polygon with `n ≥ 3` sides. Exactly one of `circumradius`,
`inradius`, `across_flats`, `side`.

SweepDirection.description: Direction of a sweep relative to the sketch normal (extrude) or the axis (revolve).

oneOf.description: Along +normal (extrude) / right-hand rule about the axis (revolve).
Half of the extent on each side.

Targets.description: Target bodies of a body operation (§6.0.2): `"all"` or a Ref (body, default `some`).

Thread.description:
Cosmetic thread: `true`, or `{ pitch?, depth? }` (defaults: the size's coarse pitch, the
full hole depth). `false` means no thread.

TransformRotation.description: The rotation of a `transform` (§6.13): `angle` degrees about an axis line (right-hand rule).

Via.description: Whether a member came from a named source or a broad one (§5.3).
